source: megastudy-correctRate, 풀서비스 이용자 채점 기준, 내부 실험 전용(D-0109)

metricConventions.topWrong: |P intersect A| / |P|; chance = |A|/4; exact floating-point ties
metricConventions.ranks: Average ranks for ties; constant-vector correlation null; nulls excluded from mean with counts
metricConventions.meanPrediction: All three VALID repeats required per question; arithmetic mean, no rounding before comparisons
metricConventions.stability: Three equal P sets; population SD (ddof=0); all 3 pairwise tag Jaccards and transform equality; empty/empty Jaccard=1
metricConventions.stabilityScope: USED five questions; tags/transforms and SD include all five choices; candidate reported separately
metricConventions.citations: Per quote, normalized whitespace substring in declared source; empty quote does not match; final VALID outputs only
